scope: Automatic local Whisper startup with the existing portable TranscribeSpeech provider
architecture: Launch owns the worker process; YASMIN requests TranscribeSpeech through Capabilities2; application consumes portable /hri endpoints
activation: transcribe_speech:=true confirm_listen:=ESCUCHAR during follow_person, or the existing standalone transcribe_speech mode
worker_default: Started by launch when Whisper is the selected enabled speech provider; start_whisper_worker:=false supports external or simulated workers
startup: Load and warm up with synthetic silence before exposing the capture service; no microphone subscription during model preparation
capture_policy: Serial capture, inference, then another request while follow remains active; not uninterrupted recording or end-of-speech detection

local_real_model_preparation.input: one second of synthetic silence; no microphone

limitations: The earlier physical run did not establish whether microphone samples arrived or why its result was missing
Model preparation outside an accepted capture removes cold initialization from its lease interval; it does not prove the cause of the earlier failure
Microphone recognition and simultaneous performance with YOLO require a new physical test
Inference creates gaps between three-second capture windows
A failed optional speech capability is disabled while visual follow continues
